override.title: Umuyobozi yarengeye
override.hint: Ivyo guhindura vyama vyanditswe n'akaranga kawe k'ubuyobozi n'impamvu - ntucereze.
override.cancelBookingHint: Gusubiramwo bigaragaza ko igitabu n’igikorwa caco vyasubitswe, bisubiza uburenganzira bwo gukora ku mufatanyabikorwa, kandi bikareka uwuwubaka agasubira gutora iyo nzira.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Gukuraho ubu bubiko? Komisiyo yayo na yo nyene irakurwaho. Ivyo vyanditswe n'izina ryawe n'impamvu yawe.

detail.disputeOpen: Intambara y’ubutunzi irafunguye kuri uwo mukiriya - uwundi mufatanyabikorwa avuga ko ari iyabo. Bifatwa ku rupapuro rw’Impari.

cancellation.title: Gusaba gusubirwamwo
cancellation.hint: Ivyo gutora n’ivyo gutanga birakurwaho; ubutunzi bw’ibikorwa buragarutse ku mufatanyabikorwa kandi uwuwubaka arashobora gusubira gusaba iyo nzira.

disputes.title: Intambara z'ubunywanyi
disputes.hint: Umufatanyabikorwa yanse kwandikwa nk’iyindi, arashobora guharira uwufise umukiriya. Suzuma izo mpande zompi maze ufate ingingo.

detail.title: Intambara {{id}}
detail.noteRequired: Wandike akajambo kugira ngo ufate ingingo.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} agumya umukiriya. Intambara irafunga nta kindi gihinduka.
detail.overturnEffect: Uburinzi bw'ibiri muri {{holder}} burahera ubu kandi umukiriya yanditswe kuri {{partner}} nk'ukwiyandikisha gushasha.
